messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] KV_CACHE metadata growth spike in prod-eu-1 — metric kv_metadata_bytes > 95th percentile. Continuous batching trend elevated. Auto-escalation to eng-sre at 14:02Z.
meera: grabbing this, moving to #incident-war-room. oncall: meera (me).
alex: flags from telemetry — large increase in avg batch window after 14:00 deploy, correlated with a new batching heuristic. seeing metadata_entries climb and eviction not keeping up.
emily: customers reporting increased tail latency and some 502s (ingest paths). tickets: CUST-47, PARTNER-X.
meera: initial triage: block manager's metadata queue grew, eviction loop stalled. suspect change in continuous-batching that increased kv-affinity and prevented early block drop.
alex: logs show repeated warn: `blockmgr: eviction_cycle_skipped=true reason=active_batches` and metadata_entries ~ 11.8M. snippet:```
2026-03-15T14:01:58Z WARN blockmgr: metadata_entries=11823745 eviction_queue_len=2 active_batch_count=412
2026-03-15T14:02:05Z WARN runtime: batch_window_ms=85 -> increase triggered by heuristic
```
meera: mitigation plan: 1) rollback batching heuristic (toggle feature flag) 2) force eviction cycle tuning (reduce block_retention_ms) 3) apply temporary throttle for heavy customers. Attempting step 1 now.
alex: prepared rollback command in prod:```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/flags/prod-eu-1 \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"continuous_batching.enabled":false}'
```
meera: executing rollback, will watch telemetry.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: starting flag update for prod-eu-1 by meera at 14:05Z.
emily: heads up — will flip throttles for CUST-47 & PARTNER-X if we still see errors after flag.
jonah: if rollback doesn't relieve backlog, we should run `blockmgr.force_eviction=true` hotpatch and set `block_retention_ms=30000`.
meera: flag update returned 200. now monitoring. dashboard: metadata_entries peaked at ~12M, now plateauing.
alex: nice, eviction queue started draining. see metadata_entries down to 6.1M in 2m. latency tail improving.
emily: customer tickets show reduced errors after 14:09 — notifying support to close urgent escalations if stable.
meera: applying conservative block_retention_ms change to 30s as precaution. patch applied at 14:12.
ops-bot: runtime-config: block_retention_ms updated -> 30000 by meera.
alex: quick safety note: continuous_batching=false increases small-request unit cost; watch P99 CPU on inference hosts.
meera: agreed, will watch. rolling back proper change to batching heuristic later with canary and lower window.
jonah: preparing short postmortem checklist: timeline, root-cause (heuristic mis-tuned), mitigation steps, config-change playbook, canary gating.
emily: adding customer impact summary: ~2.3% of requests experienced elevated latency/5xx for ~10m; two enterprise customers saw retries.
meera: handing off to night oncall @jonah for stable watch, will create incident doc and assign RCA. Jonah — you'll own next 12h watch and the canary rollout tomorrow.
jonah: got it. I'll keep an eye on batch_window_ms and metadata_entries and will revert further if needed.
alex: follow-up actions: 1) add assertion in runtime that forces eviction when active_batch_count > X 2) add a metric alert for eviction_queue_len stalling 3) create a smaller canary for batching heuristic 4) temp cost update to finance for increased small-request CPU.
meera: adding those to the incident doc. thanks all. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated) — core symptoms resolved, monitoring in watch state. next: RCA doc in /incidents/2387654321-kv-metadata-drift.
meera: filing RCA now, will ping when ready. handing complete.
jonah: acknowledged, will run watch checks every 30m for the next 12h and post heartbeat here.
meera: heartbeat at 15:05Z — metrics stable, no regressions observed.
emily: support notified customers and posted incident summary to CSP.
jonah: final note — propose adding a slow-rolling canary gate to batching heuristic PRs (config gating + perf test).
